message: Vector Rebel 3.2.57 uses the proven PPE React-select filter workflow to select SCBA locations in Standard Equipment.
releaseNotes: SCBA Airpacks now reuses the proven PPE React-select native filter flow in Equipment > Standard: open Filter options, clear prior filters, search exact location options, select and verify location chips, Apply Filters, verify resulting native Filtered To chips, then scan only the requested subset. Location choices stay independently selectable each check, and no official SCBA inspection is submitted.
